title: Dominic and the Spire
author: Lior Sandoval
blurb: Lena Hartwell, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
